title: Multimodal VLM & Video-LLM Architecture: AnyRes Visual Token Budgeting & E-P-D (Encoder-Prefill-Decode) Disaggregation Benchmark

workload_assumptions.input_mix: High-Res 1080p/4K Document & UI Screenshots + Multi-Turn QA

tiers.name: Tier 1: Monolithic Colocated ViT+Prefill+Decode + Uncapped 4K Resolution (`10,600` Vis Tokens/Img)
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern: ViT forward pass & 10.6K-token Prefill block Decode on the same GPU (68.4ms P99 TPOT!)

tiers.name: Tier 2: Colocated Engine with `max_pixels` Cap (`2,048` Vis Tokens) + `2x2` Pixel-Shuffle Merger
tiers.verdict: Controls visual token explosion, but colocated ViT + Prefill still causes 36.2ms Decode ITL spikes

tiers.name: Tier 3: 2-Stage P/D Split (ViT Colocated on H200 Prefill Nodes + Separate Decode Pool)
tiers.verdict: Protects Decode TPOT (17.8ms), but wastes expensive 141GB H200 HBM running tiny 0.6B ViT encoders

tiers.name: Tier 4: 3-Stage E-P-D Split (L40S ViT Pool -> H100 Prefill -> H200 Decode) + SHA-256 Image KV Cache
tiers.verdict: Recommended: 480ms P95 TTFT (-8.0x), 15.2ms P99 TPOT (-4.5x), 16.5 RPS/node & -78.2% cost
